cmd_link_add_refused: The runner refused to add the service
cmd_link_app_link_removed: Desktop link removed; no backup to restore. Install it with {command}.
cmd_link_app_missing: {path} not found. Run `atlas link --desktop` without `--no-build` to build it.
cmd_link_build_failed: `cargo build` failed. Fix the errors above, then run `atlas link` again.
cmd_link_creating_worktree: Creating worktree (this may take a minute)
cmd_link_desktop_build_failed: The desktop build failed. Fix the errors above, then run `atlas link --desktop` again.
cmd_link_desktop_needs_macos: `atlas link --desktop` only works with the macOS app. On this system, run the debug app directly.
cmd_link_desktop_not_installed: Atlas Desktop isn't installed. Run `atlas desktop` to install it.
cmd_link_dev_busy: `atlas dev` is running but busy. Try again in a moment.
cmd_link_dev_in_terminal: `atlas dev` is running in a terminal for {root} (pid {pid}). Quit it, or run `atlas down`, then run this command again.
cmd_link_kept_as_copy: Unlinked, but there is no release backup at {path}.
cmd_link_kept_as_copy_next: {path} is now a plain copy of the dev build, so `atlas` keeps working; run {command} to get a release.
cmd_link_no_cargo: Couldn't run `cargo`. Check that Rust is installed and `cargo` is on your PATH.
cmd_link_no_cwd: Couldn't read the current folder. Run the command from a folder that exists, or pass `--dir <workspace-root>`.
cmd_link_no_debug_binary: No debug binary at {path}. Run `cargo build -p atlas-cli` first, or run `atlas link` without `--no-build`.

match.os=windows: Couldn't find your home folder. Check that USERPROFILE is set, then run the command again.
match.os=*: Couldn't find your home folder. Check that HOME is set, then run the command again.

cmd_link_no_tauri: Couldn't run `cargo tauri`. Install it with `cargo install tauri-cli`.
cmd_link_no_workspace: Couldn't find a Cargo workspace. Run the command inside the atlas repo, or pass `--dir <workspace-root>`.
cmd_link_not_linked: atlas is not linked to a dev build. Nothing to do.
cmd_link_now_runs_debug: The installed `atlas` now runs your local debug build.
cmd_link_open_missing: {path} doesn't exist. Check the path and try again.
cmd_link_rebuild_anytime: Rebuild anytime with {command}; no reinstall needed.
cmd_link_rebuild_desktop: Rebuild with {link}, or iterate live with {dev}.
cmd_link_removed_dangling: Link removed. It pointed at a build that no longer exists, and there is no backup.
cmd_link_resolve_failed: Couldn't get the absolute path of {path}
cmd_link_runner_started: atlas runner started (pid {pid}) · attach: atlas dev · stop: atlas down
cmd_link_setup_failed: `scripts/setup.sh` failed. Fix the errors above, then run `atlas link --desktop` again.
cmd_link_symlink_windows: {reason} (Windows needs Developer Mode on to create symlinks)
cmd_link_unlinked_binary: Unlinked and restored the release binary at {path}
